title: bupleurum falcatum var. brassicifolium
intro: Bupleurum falcatum var. brassicifolium, commonly known as Hare's ear or Chinese hare's ear, is a variety of the Bupleurum falcatum plant, a species of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a traditional Chinese medicinal herb used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum falcatum var. brassicifolium include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including saikosaponins, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine and modern herbal remedies.
